newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine mills plan to buy 40,000 T U.S.wheat.
newsitem.headline: Philippine mills plan to buy 40,000 T U.S.wheat.

text.p: Two Philippine mills plan to buy 40,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for April shipment, Manila grains traders said on Tuesday.
Traders said the two mills asked price quotes from two Japanese commodity houses late on Friday.
"But the Philippine mills rejected all offers due to high prices," said one trader.
Last week, another Philippine miller also rejected bids for the supply of 25,000 tonnes of U.S. dark northern spring wheat and 15,000 tonnes of western white wheat.
"All three firms are waiting in the sidelines for price dips on the U.S. wheat markets," said one senior Manila trader.
